subject: planner: maintain a map of columns by ID in DataSource (#64053)
summary: Adds `TblColsByID` to `logicalop.DataSource` and a helper `AppendTableCol` to keep `TblCols` and the new map in sync. Initializes the map in `PlanBuilder.buildDataSource` and uses the helper when adding table columns, extra handle, and extra physical table ID columns; no functional planner/SQL semantics changes observed in this commit.
